messages.subject: For Luis Santivañez and Claudia Cooper | Sustainability, external affairs and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Antamina Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Luis Santivañez, Chief Executive Officer, and Ms. Claudia Cooper, Vice President, Sustainability & External Affairs.

Antamina's scale and stakeholder environment place sustainability, government relations, community confidence and disciplined external-affairs execution at the center of long-term operating performance. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of sustainability, external affairs, government relations and social performance might support Antamina's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Antamina.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
